title: Flavor J-Hunt Round 2: Fermionic Power Does Not Select the `J` Pairing
verdict_rationale: The displayed algebraic identities are correct, but the claimed non-selection theorem still needs a common-carrier countermodel showing that both invariant forms are admissible under the same fermionic/Berezin premises. For N1, N4, and N7, the functional-scaling and symmetry routes are attempted and no prior residual witness is used, while the strongest alternate-carrier/reality-structure route remains unresolved. For N2, N3, and N5, the three stated limitations concern distinct logical axes and the admission-like phrases are non-load-bearing boundary language, but no pairwise-closure record or five-resolution live rhetoric test is supplied. For N6 and N8, the indexed partial-closure candidates and cross-cycle echoes are not dispositioned by live evidence; the surviving result is only the individual determinant/Frobenius and covariance identities, and the next test is an explicit same-premise I/J fermionic realization comparison.
